prompt.zh-TW: 年底，初陽貿易帳上只有 {{money:vars.cash}} 可以動用，卻同時面對三個要求：員工期待年終獎金、銀行希望提前還一部分借款、股東想要股利。錢只夠做一件事，你會先滿足誰？
prompt.en: At year end First Light Trading has only {{money:vars.cash}} available, yet faces three demands at once: staff expect a year-end bonus, the bank would like part of the loan repaid early, and shareholders want a dividend. There is only enough for one. Whom would you satisfy first?

upside.zh-TW: 留住人才、維持士氣；明年的營收靠的是這群人。
upside.en: Keeps people and morale; next year’s revenue depends on them.

downside.zh-TW: 銀行與股東都落空；若明年景氣轉差，提前還款的機會也錯過了。
downside.en: Both the bank and shareholders go without; if next year turns down, the chance to reduce debt early is lost.

text.en: Repay part of the loan early

upside.zh-TW: 利息負擔下降、信用紀錄變好，未來的借款條件更有利。
upside.en: Interest falls, the credit record improves, and future borrowing terms get better.

downside.zh-TW: 員工士氣受挫，可能流失；股東覺得公司只顧銀行。
downside.en: Staff morale suffers and people may leave; shareholders feel the company only looks after the bank.

upside.zh-TW: 回應出資者的期待，維持股東對公司的信心與支持。
upside.en: Answers the expectations of those who put up the capital and keeps their confidence and support.

downside.zh-TW: 員工與債權人都會問：為什麼錢先給了股東？下一次需要他們配合時會更難。
downside.en: Staff and creditors will ask why shareholders came first; the next time their cooperation is needed, it will be harder to get.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 這類情境沒有讓三方都滿意的方案，重點是說清楚優先順序的理由：例如哪一項已經有約定或快要到期、哪一項延後的代價最小（股利由公司決定是否發放）。許多公司會把一筆錢拆開、各給一部分，但那只是把取捨變小，不是消除取捨。能說出「我為什麼先選這個、其他人要怎麼補償」，就是這一題要練的能力。
viewpoint.en: In situations like this no option satisfies all three; what matters is a clear reason for the order of priority: for example, which item is already promised or about to fall due, and which costs least to defer (whether to pay a dividend is the company’s decision). Many companies split the money and give each party a part, but that shrinks the trade-off rather than removing it. Being able to say why you chose this first and how the others will be made good is the skill this question practises.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
